newsitem.title: SPAIN: S&P sees growing demand for Spain insurer ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P sees growing demand for Spain insurer ratings.

text.p: U.S.-based rating agency Standard & Poor's sees a rising demand for ratings among Spanish insurers amid growing competition and demands for transparency.
"We expect substantial development of ratings in the insurance sector in Spain," Juan de la Mota, director of S&P in Spain, told a seminar on Tuesday.
At present S&P has rated 11 companies in the Spanish insurance sector, where foreign interests have a 40 percent market share.
The range of ratings given goes from A+ for Mapfre Re.Cia de Reaseguros, the reinsurance unit of Corporacion Mapfre to BB for Union Fenix-Seguros y Reaseguros.
The remainder of the companies are rated BBB.
